topic: How NASA Rescued Voyager 1's Broken Memory
centralQuestion: How did engineers restore readable data from an unreachable spacecraft with failed memory?
thesis: Relocating and reconnecting software can work around permanently failed memory hardware.
viewerPayoff: See code divided among spare working memory locations and references updated, while the damaged chip stays failed.
